terms.title: Hard Light
terms.guideSubtitle: A space opera setting for the Legend Dynamics RPG system
terms.journalIntro: Write it together at the end of a mission. Advancements apply to the GM's copies; use each card's Save character file to send a player their update.
terms.journalTitlePlaceholder: e.g. The derelict at Kessa's Reach
terms.reloadDone: Fresh power cell in: full charge.
terms.emptyNote: Drained: it won't fire until recharged or given a fresh cell.
terms.otherWeapon: Ship's guns or another weapon (no charge)
terms.tracksIntro: Shields take hits first; then the Hull and a system (1d6: Weapons, Engines, Sensors, Comms, Life support, GM's choice). Tap a box to mark or clear it.
terms.formCoreSummary: Shapeshifting rules: changing is a free action; strong emotion can force it (Will roll); the alternate form's profile applies while changed

roles.name: Captain
roles.text: Captain: commands the ship and crew, and makes the decisions no one else wants to.

roles.name: Pilot
roles.text: Pilot: flies the ship and its shuttles through anything, at any speed, on a dare.

roles.name: Diplomat
roles.text: Diplomat: speaks for the crew to governments, warlords and strangers, and keeps the peace when it can be kept.

roles.name: Scientist
roles.text: Scientist: reads the anomaly, explains it to the captain, and wants to get closer.

roles.name: Medic
roles.text: Medic: patches up the crew, from a medkit on a hostile world to surgery in sickbay.

roles.name: Navigator
roles.text: Navigator: plots the jump, finds the way through, and knows where the ship is when no one else does.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.text: Engineer: keeps the engines running and the lights on, and improvises when the parts run out.

roles.name: Security
roles.text: Security: first through the airlock, last to leave, and the one who decides when the blaster stays on stun.

roles.name: Comms
roles.text: Comms officer: opens the channel, breaks the code, and hears what a signal is really saying.

skills: Coordinate people and give clear orders
Lie, bluff, disguise and talk your way past
Read behavior, motives and emotional state
Operate ship sensors or a hand scanner
Analyze energy, matter, space and hyperspace
Repair and modify engines, power, machines and electronics
Program, retrieve data and break into systems
Fly a starship, shuttle or skimmer
Plot jumps and courses and fix position
Climb, swim, jump, run and move in zero-g
Shelter, water and hazards on a hostile world
formCore: A free action, in or out.
Strong emotion or pain can force a change: when it matters, the GM calls for a Will roll.
While changed, your alternate form's attribute bonuses apply to rolls on those attributes and their skills, even above the starting maximum, and its traits and drawbacks apply too.

origins.name: Human
origins.desc: Adaptable, stubborn and everywhere. Humans built the Concord with the other peoples of the Reach, and argue about it constantly.
traits: +2 to Will when refusing to abandon a crewmate or give up on a rescue.
You keep going after the odds have clearly turned. Accept the danger, delay or lost resource.
+2 to Psychology when judging, face to face, whether someone is lying.
You act on an unproven feeling when procedure says wait. Accept the cost when the hunch is wrong.

origins.name: Vashari
origins.desc: Slender, violet-eyed empaths who feel the emotions of everyone nearby. Vashari make gifted diplomats and healers, and hate crowds.
core: Empathy: you feel the strong emotions of anyone within a few steps, without words. Shielded or alien minds may be closed to you.
traits: +2 to Psychology to read someone's feelings face to face.
Strong emotions nearby overwhelm you. Accept −2 on your next action when rage, terror or grief fill the room.
+2 to Diplomacy to calm a frightened or angry person.
You won't stand by while someone is hurt for sport. Accept the trouble when you intervene.

origins.name: Korrin
origins.desc: Broad, dense people from a heavy-gravity world, enormously strong and nearly as stubborn. Korrin speak bluntly and work hard.
traits: +2 to Athletics for feats of raw strength: lifting, forcing, holding.
Normal gravity feels like walking on ice. Accept the stumble or the broken fixture at a bad time.
+2 to Body to resist crushing, cold and toxins.
Your honesty offends someone who matters. Accept the lost goodwill.

origins.name: Ylith
origins.desc: Feathered, hollow-boned people from a world of sky-cities. Ylith see farther than anyone, glide on their wings, and hate tight spaces.
core: Wings: in standard gravity or less, you can glide down from any height and land safely.
traits: +2 to Intellect rolls to spot detail at a distance.
Cramped spaces make you panic. Accept −2 on your next action, or refuse to go in.
Ability: in standard gravity or less and breathable air, fly short distances. Roll Athletics for hard flying.
Your light bones break easily. When a fall, crush or heavy blow hits you, accept one extra injury box.

origins.name: Tessan
origins.desc: Scaled, long-lived traders who carry their families' debts and contracts for generations. A Tessan's word is a contract.
traits: +2 to Body to resist heat, radiation and toxic air.
Cold slows you down. When it's a real factor, accept −2 on physical actions or stop to warm up.
+2 to Diplomacy when bargaining, buying or selling.
Your family owes, or is owed. Accept the obligation when it comes due.

origins.name: Mirrun
origins.desc: Smooth-skinned amphibians from an ocean world, quick in water and quicker to laugh. Mirrun feel vibrations through their skin.
core: Amphibious: you breathe water as well as air, and swim as fast as you run.
traits: +2 to Intellect rolls to sense movement nearby, in the dark or behind you.
Dry air sickens you. Without water for a day, accept −2 on physical actions until you soak.
+2 to Athletics in water and in zero-g.
Loud noise and engine thrum disorient you. Accept −2 on your next action when it hits.

origins.name: Kel
origins.desc: Chitin-plated people raised in great hive-cities, logical, cooperative and unsettled by being alone. Other peoples find Kel hard to read.
traits: +2 to Leadership when coordinating a group on a single task.
Isolation distresses you. Accept −2 on Will rolls, or a rash choice, when cut off from the crew.
+2 to Body to resist being knocked out or stunned.
Others can't read your expressions. Accept the misunderstanding when it matters.

origins.name: Synth
origins.desc: Free artificial minds in synthetic bodies. The Concord recognized Synths as people only a generation ago, and not everyone agrees.
core: Synthetic: you don't breathe, eat or sleep, and disease and poison don't affect you. Medicine can't treat you; Engineering repairs you instead, by the same rules.
Computers is always at least Trained, free.
traits: +2 to Intellect rolls to recall exactly something you have seen, heard or read.
People distrust a machine that thinks. Accept the suspicion or the refusal.
Ability: by touch, link to a computer and roll Computers without a console.
Intrusion attacks can reach you. When a hostile system fights back, accept the glitch.

origins.name: Drennari
origins.desc: Long-lived, pale psionics who remember centuries. Drennari read minds by touch and sometimes glimpse what hasn't happened yet.
core: Mind touch: by touch, roll Will to sense surface thoughts; a resisting mind uses an opposed Will contest. The GM sets the limits before the roll.
traits: Ability: by touch, roll Will to share memories with a willing or restrained mind. You learn only what they know.
Fragments of other minds linger. Accept −2 on your next Will roll, or an unfamiliar emotion, at a time that matters.
Ability: once per session, ask the GM one yes-or-no question about the next hour, and get a true answer.
Visions come unbidden. Accept losing your next action when one strikes at a bad time.

origins.name: Vorr
origins.desc: Shapeshifters who can wear any face, and who have a war shape of claws and armored hide. The Hegemony hunts them; the Concord doesn't trust them.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
drawbacks: Unmistakably alien: anyone who sees it knows what you are

traits: Ability: after studying someone for a scene, take on their face and voice. Roll Deception to pass as them.
Wear a face too long and you start to become them. Accept the slip when it matters.
+2 to Athletics to squeeze through gaps or slip bonds.
Hegemony purists hunt your kind. Accept the danger when they find you.

origins.name: Aethari
origins.desc: Beings of living light who walk among others in sealed containment suits. Unsuited, an Aethari blazes like a star, and burns.
core: Containment suit: you live in a sealed suit. Out of it you're in your alternate form, and mark a box each hour that rest can't clear until you return.
Light burst: in your alternate form, roll Will; everyone nearby rolls Body −2 or loses their next action, blinded.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
drawbacks: Fading: a box an hour outside the suit

traits: +2 to Sensors or Intellect rolls to sense energy, power sources and radiation.
You think in ways others can't follow. Accept the misunderstanding when it matters.
Ability: in your alternate form, roll Will to clear one injury box from someone you touch, once per scene.
Your suit can fail. When a hit or a hazard threatens it, accept the breach.

allegiances: Once per mission, help from a navy ship or station: supplies, repairs or an escort.
Duty: navy orders, and the navy's enemies.
Once per mission, money, a cargo, or a door opened.
Duty: the house's interests come first, and its rivals are yours.
Once per mission, a fence, a forger or a safe berth.
Duty: the Syndicate calls in favors, and the law knows your face.
Once per mission, records, star charts or a scholar's help.
Duty and Vow: share what you find, and keep the Archive's secrets.
Duty: your people's cause, and the Hegemony's attention.
reasons: Explore
To see what's out there: worlds and wonders no one has charted yet.
Family tradition
My family has always flown, and I mean to live up to the name.
Discovery
The best laboratory in the galaxy is a ship on the frontier.
Protect others
To protect the people who can't protect themselves.
A hero's example
A starship crew once saved my world, and I want to be that crew for someone else.
Freedom
No planet can hold me, and no one gives me orders I don't choose.
Prove myself
To prove I'm good enough, to everyone who doubted me and to myself.
Leave the past behind
To leave behind a past, a world, or a life that was too small for me.
Make amends
To make up for a mistake I can't undo.
Fortune
There's a fortune out there, and I mean to find it.
connections: Academy classmates
We trained together, and we still look out for each other.
They saved my life
They pulled me out of a burning shuttle, and I owe them my life.
I saved theirs
I saved their life on a past voyage, and they haven't forgotten it.
Mentor
They took me under their wing when I first came aboard.
Friendly rivals
We competed for the same berth, and the rivalry is still mostly friendly.
Same homeworld
We grew up on the same world and know each other's families.
An unpaid favor
I owe them a favor I haven't repaid yet.
A shared secret
We share a secret from a mission neither of us talks about.
Off-duty friends
We meet every week in the galley for cards, music or bad stories.
Unfinished business
They blame me for something that went wrong on a past mission.
advantages: +2 to Medicine for delicate surgery or removing a dangerous embedded object.
+2 to Medicine for emergency stabilization of a wounded patient.
Choose one species or narrow biological group. +2 to Medicine or Life Sciences with that group.
+2 to Physical Sciences when analyzing hyperspace and jump phenomena.
+2 to Intellect rolls to notice a concealed physical clue during a deliberate search.
+2 to Communications when separating a real signal from noise or spotting a disguised one.
+2 to Computers when breaking into a system or tracing an intrusion.
+2 to Engineering for a temporary repair with inadequate but workable materials.
+2 to Piloting for hazardous maneuvers in a small craft.
+2 to Diplomacy when negotiating across a cultural misunderstanding you have identified.
+2 to Leadership when coordinating an immediate response to a sudden emergency.
+2 to Will to keep concentrating despite pain or severe distraction.
+2 to Will to resist psionic intrusion or compulsion.
+2 to Blasters after spending your preceding action aiming at the same visible target.
+2 to Athletics and Close Combat in zero gravity.
complications: A strange reading or discovery tempts you to linger, spend something scarce, or take a risky look. Accept a specific cost.
You shield someone or volunteer for a hazardous rescue at a real cost to yourself.
You put the job ahead of exhaustion, injury or a personal need. Accept a concrete setback.
An order conflicts with your ethics. Accept the delay, challenge or consequence of refusing it.
You insist on procedure when improvising would be faster. Accept the lost time or opportunity.
A troubling order makes you demand answers at a critical moment. Accept the delay or strain.
Pride tempts you to refuse help or take on too much. Take a real consequence when it matters.
A reminder of the war with the Hegemony causes hesitation or a hard choice. Define the reminder together.
You resist a mind touch or psionic help that could solve the problem. Accept the cost.
Your customs clash with a local practice. Accept the misunderstanding or lost opportunity.
A recurring rival complicates your work with concrete problems.
A family or a love pulls you away from the work.
There's a price on your head somewhere. Accept trouble when bounty hunters or the law come.
A debt to dangerous people comes due. Accept their demand.
An agreed secret threatens trust or safety. Earn a point when protecting or revealing it has a real consequence.
You set the blaster to stun even when it costs you. Accept the extra danger.

A derelict no one has catalogued

Civilians are caught in the danger
Someone volunteers for a deadly job in your place
duty: You're hurt or exhausted, but your station needs you
A personal message arrives in the middle of a crisis
Your relief is late and the work can't wait
conscience: An order would harm civilians or prisoners
You're ordered to leave someone behind
Your superiors hide the truth from the people it affects
book: A shortcut skips a safety check
Someone asks you to bend a rule just this once
distrust: An order comes with no explanation
Orders from far away ignore what's happening here
reputation: Someone questions your competence in front of others
A task in your field is beyond you
Getting help means admitting a mistake
war: Meeting someone who fought on the other side
A world that looks like the one you lost
telepaths: A telepath joins the landing party
A psionic intrusion affects the crew
culture: A local custom clashes with your own
A formal ceremony where every gesture matters
Negotiating with a people your own distrust
rival: Your rival is after the same prize
Your rival takes credit for your work
home: The mission passes near your homeworld
Someone you love is in danger
wanted: A bounty hunter docks at the same station
Your face on a wanted list
debt: Your creditor wants a favor instead
secret: Someone starts asking the wrong questions
Evidence that could expose you turns up
Keeping the secret means lying to a friend
nonlethal: The only fast solution would kill someone

equipment: Talks to the ship and the landing party within range. Interference, shielding or distance can cut it off.
Reads life signs, energy, materials and air at short range. Field Sensors rolls need one.
Identifies ordinary injuries automatically. Diagnosing unfamiliar biology without one is very difficult (−4).
Drugs, dressings and injectors. Needed for emergency stabilization and field treatment.
Hand tools, spare parts and test gear. Needed for most Engineering in the field.
12 charge. Settings and costs are under Blaster charge.
Lets you talk with speakers of known languages. A new language takes time and a Communications roll.
Hours of air in vacuum or poison atmosphere. −2 to Agility-based actions and Stealth while worn.
Rations, water, light, rope and shelter for a few days. Makes impossible survival tasks ordinary.
Broadcasts your position to the ship.
Carries heavy loads or a casualty at walking pace. Hard to move quietly (−2 Stealth).

quickRef: Fists, batons, knives: 1 box. Vibroblades, blaster bolts: 2. Overcharged bolt: 3 and Dying. Stun: Body −2 roll, no box.
Target rolls Body −2: failure, out for the scene; success, −2 on their next action.
Holdout 6, pistol 12, carbine 24. Stun 1, bolt 1, overcharged 3, wide stun 3. A spare cell refills it.
Shields (3) take hits first; then Hull (4) and a system (3: −2, −4, offline). Piloting evades once per exchange; Engineering clears a box.

example.name: Mara Okonkwo
example.role: Scientist: reads the anomaly, explains it to the captain, and wants to get closer.
example.reason: The best laboratory in the galaxy is a ship on the frontier.
example.connection: Owes the chief engineer for rebuilding her scanner after the Kessa incident.

comp.trigger: An unexplained reading while the crew is ordered to leave

example.contact: A researcher at the Archive who'll check a theory, quietly

pregens.name: Ilsa Varga
pregens.role: Commands the ship, keeps the crew alive, and takes the jobs that need doing.
pregens.reason: To protect the people who can't protect themselves.
pregens.connection: Rhen Valo once wore her face to get her out of a Hegemony prison.

comp.trigger: You're hurt or exhausted, but your station needs you

pregens.name: Kesh
pregens.role: Flies anything, through anything, and gets bored in a straight line.
pregens.reason: No planet can hold me, and no one gives me orders I don't choose.
pregens.connection: Brakka keeps rebuilding the flight controls Kesh keeps breaking.

comp.trigger: Your rival is after the same prize

pregens.name: Dr. Oru Tamsin
pregens.role: Feels every patient's pain, and treats it anyway.
pregens.reason: To make up for a mistake I can't undo.
pregens.connection: Sable is the only patient Oru can't feel, and Oru finds that restful.

comp.trigger: Civilians are caught in the danger

pregens.name: Brakka
pregens.role: Keeps the engines running on spit and stubbornness, and tells you exactly why your idea won't work.
pregens.reason: To prove I'm good enough, to everyone who doubted me and to myself.
pregens.connection: Brakka and Kesh have a standing bet on whether the ship survives Kesh's next maneuver.

comp.trigger: Orders from far away ignore what's happening here

pregens.name: Sable
pregens.role: Reads the anomaly, names the risk, and calculates the odds no one asked for.
pregens.reason: To see what's out there: worlds and wonders no one has charted yet.
pregens.connection: Captain Varga signed Sable's papers of personhood when no one else would.

pregens.name: Rhen Valo
pregens.role: First through the airlock, wearing whatever face gets the crew home.
pregens.reason: To leave behind a past, a world, or a life that was too small for me.
pregens.connection: Dr. Tamsin is the only one who's seen Rhen's true face.
